question: The value of 17 - [16 - {38 - (49 - 72 ÷ 16 × 4 of 2)}] is:
solution:
Concept Used: 

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0dde522f65134a981f8db6f1ac5aebe5108510a68c758df909f765f209687bd.png] 

Calculation:

17 – [16 – {38 – (49 – 72 ÷ 16 × 4 of 2)}]

⇒ 17 – [16 – {38 – (49 – 72 ÷ 16 × 8)}]

⇒ 17 – [16 – {38 – (49 – 9/2 × 8)}]

⇒ 17 – [16 – {38 – (49 – 36)}]

⇒ 17 – [16 – {38 – 13}]

⇒ 17 – [16 – 25]

⇒ 17 – (-9)

⇒ 17 + 9

⇒ 26

**∴ The required value is 26**
